entries.en: I mean, it was all right.
It's just – why's the main character so naive?
entries.ro: E doar – de ce e personajul principal atât de naiv?

entries.en: What, having a dream makes you naive?
entries.ro: Ce, a avea un vis te face naiv?

entries.en: You even serious right now? There's no dreaming in a megacorp, I'll tell you that.
entries.ro: Serios acum? În megacorporație nu ai loc de visuri, îți spun eu.

entries.en: So what are you doing at Kiroshi, then?
entries.ro: Și atunci ce faci la Kiroshi?
